canonical_statement: For a finite-dimensional complex matrix path L on a real time domain, a Lax equation dL/dt = [P,L] together with explicitly supplied conjugating evolution preserves the spectrum of L across the domain.
domain_and_universes: universe u; n : Type u; Fintype n; DecidableEq n; L P : Real -> Matrix n n Complex; timeDomain : Set Real; Prop in universe 0
ordered_binders: L P : Real -> Matrix n n Complex
conclusion: IsospectralOn L timeDomain: for any t0 and t in the domain, spectrum Complex (L t) = spectrum Complex (L t0)
source_relationship: The checked iff directly expands the finite-matrix Lax equation, conjugation, and spectrum predicates selected at intake. The historical local module remains discovery input and supplies no proof credit.

killed: removed the Lax-equation hypothesis and its P binder
changed the arbitrary finite index type to Fin n
changed binder scope to require one global conjugating unit

degenerate_cases: The empty time domain, singleton domains, constant paths, and zero-dimensional finite matrix models remain admitted. No connectedness or nonempty-domain condition is silently added.
excluded_scope: universal existence of Lax representations for every notion of integrable system
construction of conjugating evolution from analytic ODE hypotheses
unbounded operators, PDE domains, and inverse-scattering completeness
status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates the exact intake-selected conditional target with two pinned imports, a checked direct expansion, four structural mutations, and boundary checks. It provides no proof of the Lax theorem or any dependent phase.
